summary: Frontend-only verification of Sound & Haptics toggle and Admission Revenue PIN unlock greeting. Sound & Haptics card + toggle renders on /settings for BOTH super admin and staff, is ON by default, persists to localStorage key 'finflow_sound_haptics' as '0'/'1', and survives a page reload. Admission Revenue PIN gate is present for super admin (page is protected) so gate rendering is verified; PIN value is not known to the harness, so the actual verify → 'Unlocked!' celebration overlay could not be exercised end-to-end — reported informational per instructions. customFor() in lib/api.js correctly maps /pin/verify to caption/title 'Unlocked!' and subtitle "You're in — here's your confidential revenue." via code review.

Admission Revenue: pin-gate/pin-enter-form rendered for super admin (PIN is set). Correct 'Unlocked!' greeting wiring exists in lib/api.js customFor() for URLs ending in '/pin/verify'.
